## Round-Robin Lead Assignment
Called by a HubSpot workflow ("Send a webhook" action) when a new lead needs an owner. Picks the next eligible rep (skips inactive, out-of-office, and at-capacity reps), falls back to a default owner, and alerts Slack when it had to fall back.

**WRITES to HubSpot** (sets hubspot_owner_id) only when `SANDBOX_MODE=false`. In sandbox mode it returns the decision without changing anything.
Protect the webhook with the Header Auth credential. Use at your own risk - see DISCLAIMER.md.

nodes.name: Count Open Leads
nodes.notes: Counts each rep's open leads (capped at 100 results) for capacity checks.

nodes.name: Pick Rep
nodes.notes: Round-robin + eligibility rules. Rotation state lives in workflow static data.

nodes.name: Assign Owner
nodes.notes: The only write in this repository: sets hubspot_owner_id.

nodes.name: Skip Write
nodes.notes: Sandbox mode, already owned, or nobody to assign: nothing is written to HubSpot.

nodes.name: Post Fallback Alert
nodes.notes: Slack incoming webhook URL comes from the SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL environment variable.
